name: Loading bar get-ready
hook: A bare-faced creator with a 0% counter on screen.
mechanic: A loading counter runs from 0% to 100% over a get-ready routine, with hard cuts at each stage.
why_works: The counter turns a routine into a progress bar people want to see finish.
brand_usage: Show the product at 30% and the finished look at 100%.
prompt: Vertical 9:16 video. Shot 1: [AVATAR] bare-faced with [PRODUCT], '0%' on screen. Shot 2: mid-routine, '60%'. Shot 3: finished look, '100%'.
swaps: Swap: the person, the product, the routine. Never copy: the original creator's likeness or audio.

name: Toy to real transform
hook: A toy on a window sill with the real thing passing outside.
mechanic: The toy and the real object line up in frame and the toy becomes real.
why_works: One clean visual trick that needs no words.
brand_usage: Swap the toy for a product miniature and the real object for the product in use.
prompt: Vertical 9:16 CGI shot. A miniature [PRODUCT] on a train window sill, the landscape passing, the miniature grows into the full-size [PRODUCT] outside.
swaps: Swap: the object, the setting. Never copy: third-party brands visible in the original.
